prompt:

choices.text: Hàm số <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> đồng biến trên khoảng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>+</mo><mi>∞</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math>
